$comment: Input for build.mjs. Copy next to a card folder as kit.config.json, edit, then: node <toolkit>/assets/sandbox-kit/build.mjs --config kit.config.json --card <dir>. Keys starting with $ are ignored.
$language: The language --emit-contract writes its framing sentences and sample values in: en or zh-Hant. On a non-English card give every field an example in that language; a field without one gets a generic sample the model may copy.

overrides.$comment: Design-time overrides of preset tokens, per side. Keep both sides in step.

fields.label: Mood
fields.rule: one word; changes only when the scene gives a reason

extra.$comment: Card-specific CSS and JS appended after the kit. The JS can use window.HR.
